offer.text: The horns are sounding — raiders are on the village! Hold the wall and cut down eight of the attackers before they put the homes to the torch!

accept.text: To the wall, then! Break their charge!

decline.text: Then bar your door and pray the gate holds.

in_progress.text: They're still coming! Eight of the raiders down — that's what we need!

ready.text: Their line's breaking — you've turned the tide!

complete.text: The village still stands, and that's your doing. We won't forget who held the gate.

failed.text: They got through despite us. We'll be a long time counting the cost.
